capabilities: Focus file explorer on active note
Display open task counts on notes
extras: The plugin relies on undocumented parts of the Obsidian API and may stop working after future Obsidian updates.
intentEvidence: Pharos fixes both, in the tree itself.
motivation: Obsidian's file explorer keeps every folder you have ever opened open, making large vaults unreadable, and it doesn't show where work is waiting.
problem: The standard file explorer becomes unreadable in large vaults, and it fails to indicate which notes or folders contain outstanding tasks without manual expansion.
summary: File explorer enhancement that focuses on the active note and displays the count of open tasks within notes and folders.
